name: MemGrid
summary: MemGrid is a polished and fast-paced memory-matching puzzle game that challenges your concentration, recall, and strategic thinking under pressure. Whether you're looking for a quick brain-training session or a competitive duel, you can play solo against an AI opponent with adjustable difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, and Hard) or challenge a friend in local multiplayer, where every turn is limited by a strict 15-second timer. Designed for endless replayability, MemGrid offers multiple board sizes ranging from beginner-friendly layouts to an intense 12×12 master-level challenge. Personalize your experience with Dark Mode and multiple background themes, including Slate Gray, Mint Green, Soft Rose, and Ocean Blue. Track your progress through a detailed statistics system that records every win, loss, and draw across all game modes, allowing you to measure your improvement and strive for mastery with every match.
